scope: IM12 RI01-RI05, proposal carriers, F07, F11, four HTML entries, and four PDFs only

findings.finding: manifest hashes and R4 file declarations must be refreshed
findings.resolution: final manifest refresh is required after this QA artifact and before the persisted self-check

findings.finding: pre-R4 self_check cannot evidence the candidate
findings.resolution: the complete four-gate persisted self-check is required after final manifest refresh

findings.finding: RI01 lacked the exact four-path service comparison and SC08/SC12 anchors
findings.resolution: fixed: AI, human, paper/low-tech, and failure-handoff paths plus SC08/SC12 are explicit

findings.finding: RI02 lacked TVS-1-3 and safety classification
findings.resolution: fixed: TVS-1-3, professional Gate, safety class, and data class are explicit

findings.finding: RI02 task-card acceptance chain was incomplete
findings.resolution: fixed: question to hypothesis to scenario to determinacy constraints to human/professional review to stop is explicit

findings.finding: RI03 lacked F10/SC11/SC12 and the six tabletop states
findings.resolution: fixed: all anchors and normal/crowding/offline/mistranslation/uncertain/takeover states are explicit

findings.finding: RI04 lacked C01-C09, SC10, power-off, human substitution, and a complete handover chain
findings.resolution: fixed: all existing anchors and handover questions are explicit without a new canonical ID

findings.finding: RI05 lacked the nine-state/fifteen-transition baseline and four result classes
findings.resolution: fixed: frozen protocol, evidence grades, adverse results, takeover, and all four comparison classes are explicit

findings.finding: metrics top-level summary mixed the Phase 2 baseline with package totals
findings.resolution: fixed: package 23 known / 6 unknown / 21 recomputable and Phase 2 baseline 21/19 are separate

findings.finding: R4 checker did not independently compare metric values/formulas or bilingual required fields
findings.resolution: fixed: actual contract/gate counts, formulas, values, non-empty parity fields, internal anchors, and reviewer roles are asserted

findings.finding: F11 readiness overlapped the complaint path and resembled a lifecycle row
findings.resolution: fixed: standalone F11 uses a separate header block; native A3/A0 use a separate governance card restored from a clean Phase 3 base

findings.finding: F11 registry lifecycle-separated claim was not supported by the prior rendering
findings.resolution: fixed: the current rendering now supports the registry statement

findings.finding: F11 text sizes contradicted the generation contract
findings.resolution: fixed: standalone new text is at least 21 px; native contracts separately state A3 8 pt and A0 18 pt minima

findings.finding: R4 generation hashes omitted assumptions and two actual generated contracts
findings.resolution: fixed: assumptions and Phase 3 base inputs are bound; Phase 4 freeze and generation contracts are bound as outputs

findings.finding: rights ledger did not cover R4 files and regeneration
findings.resolution: fixed: path-level contract, generator, figure, HTML, PDF, and no-new-third-party-material terms are recorded

findings.finding: minimum inbound fields repeated authorization/role rather than object-specific facts
findings.resolution: fixed: object-specific factual inputs remain inbound; roles and authorization remain in their dedicated fields

findings.finding: review triggers did not name a reviewer role type
findings.resolution: fixed: every interface has a bilingual reviewer role type

findings.finding: the ETDA English entity label could imply resolved identity
findings.resolution: fixed: the assumption and target state say taskbook-named scope with exact entity unresolved

findings.finding: changelog lacked an R4 closeout entry
findings.resolution: fixed: one concise R4 entry records scope, 5/0/0, visuals, metrics, and non-claim boundary
